decisions.reason: The firm has sunk tooling and catalogue investment into this multi-model lever handle family, and it fits the coordinated-range strategy, so management will keep backing it into its third year.
The mitred family embodies the firm's proprietary engineering and design identity, so sunk development costs and brand commitment outweigh its modest visibility.
The line is embedded in planning documentation and the coordinated handle families, which makes withdrawal unlikely while weaker results can still be put down to market ramp-up.
The award-winning collection has its own page and was publicly promoted, so its visible commitment and proven success make dropping it very unlikely.
The finish is cheap to maintain, applies across product families and supports the firm's finishing expertise and sustainability positioning, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
